scripts.build: tsc && tsc --project tsconfig.browser.json && vite build --config vite.config.cjs
scripts.generate_all: npm run codegen && npm run soliditygen && npm run rename_contract
scripts.generate_all:top_level_merkle_proof: npm run codegen:top_level_merkle_proof && npm run soliditygen:top_level_merkle_proof && npm run rename_contract:top_level_merkle_proof
scripts.soliditygen: npm run soliditygen:top_level_merkle_proof && npm run soliditygen:sub_tree_merkle_proof && npm run soliditygen:generic_tree_proof && npm run soliditygen:encrypt_proof && npm run soliditygen:validated_sig_he_add && npm run soliditygen:generic_adjacent_tree_proof
scripts.rename_contract: npm run rename_contract:top_level_merkle_proof && npm run rename_contract:sub_tree_merkle_proof && npm run rename_contract:generic_tree_proof && npm run rename_contract:encrypt_proof && npm run rename_contract:validated_sig_he_add && npm run rename_contract:generic_adjacent_tree_proof
scripts.codegen: npm run codegen:top_level_merkle_proof && npm run codegen:mimc_test && npm run codegen:sub_tree_merkle_proof && npm run codegen:generic_tree_proof && npm run codegen:encrypt_proof && npm run codegen:validated_sig_he_add && npm run codegen:generic_adjacent_tree_proof
scripts.codegen:top_level_merkle_proof: cd noir-circuits && nargo compile && npx noir-codegen ./noir-circuits/target/top_level_merkle_proof.json --out-dir ./src/tscircuits/top_level_merkle_proof && cp ./target/top_level_merkle_proof.json ../src/tscircuits/top_level_merkle_proof/top_level_merkle_proof.json

scripts.soliditygen:top_level_merkle_proof: cd noir-circuits && mkdir -p ./target/top_level_merkle_proof && bb write_vk -b ./target/top_level_merkle_proof.json -o ./target/top_level_merkle_proof --oracle_hash keccak && bb write_solidity_verifier -k ./target/top_level_merkle_proof/vk -o ../../privacy-lib/contracts/top_level_merkle_proof.sol

scripts.build-circom: npm run build-circom-circuits && npm run rename-circom-files2 && npm run harmonise-circom-files && ./rename_contract_circom.sh opening_proof ./circom-circuits/build/opening_proof/opening_proof.sol && npm run copy-circom-to-lib
